context: A teacher and student discuss commuting and a banner outside school
purpose: Teach: 車両/経由/地下鉄/有料/観戦/一貫/掲げ/違和感

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: おはよう、さくらさん。今日はずいぶん早いのね。
lines.en: Good morning, Sakura. You're quite early today.
lines.style: Warm teacher greeting, slightly curious about the early arrival.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: おはようございます。今朝は地下鉄が空いてて、いつもより早く着いちゃいました。
lines.en: Good morning. The subway was empty this morning, so I arrived earlier than usual.
lines.style: Cheerful teenage tone, polite but relaxed with her teacher.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: あら、新宿経由のルートに変えたって聞いたけど、慣れた?
lines.en: Oh, I heard you switched to the route via Shinjuku. Are you used to it?
lines.style: Curious, conversational, follow-up question with gentle interest.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、でも先頭車両がいつも混んでて、最初はちょっと違和感がありました。
lines.en: Yes, but the front car is always crowded, so at first it felt a bit strange.
lines.style: Honest reflection, slightly self-deprecating teenage tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうよね。ところで、校門の前に新しい横断幕が掲げてあったの、見た?
lines.en: I see. By the way, did you see the new banner hung in front of the school gate?
lines.style: Shifting topic warmly, inviting the student's observation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あ、見ました! 全国大会の観戦募集のやつですよね。有料って書いてあってびっくりしました。
lines.en: Oh, I saw it! It's the one recruiting people to watch the nationals, right? I was surprised it said paid.
lines.style: Animated teen reaction, mixing excitement and mild surprise.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうなの。学校としては応援の方針を一貫して続けたいから、参加してくれると嬉しいわ。
lines.en: That's right. As a school we want to keep our support policy consistent, so I'd be glad if you joined.
lines.style: Sincere teacher encouragement, soft persuasive warmth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 考えてみます。友達も誘って、みんなで行けたら楽しそうですね。
lines.en: I'll think about it. If I invite my friends and we all go together, it sounds fun.
lines.style: Thoughtful, opening up with friendly enthusiasm.
